title: Credential Phishing & Lookalike Domain Attacks
indicators: Links with typosquatting or mismatched brand domains (e.g. sbi-kyc-verify.top instead of sbi.co.in)
Use of URL shorteners (bit.ly, tinyurl, cutt.ly) to mask actual destinations
Urgent calls to verify passwords, ATM PINs, CVVs, or NetBanking credentials
Generic greetings combined with severe account closure threats
Punycode homograph domain characters resembling standard alphanumeric brands
guidance: Never click links sent via SMS, email, or messaging apps claiming to be your bank
Check the address bar manually by typing the verified official institution URL
Banks and payment providers will NEVER ask for your password, PIN, or CVV via SMS or web forms
If credentials were submitted by mistake, immediately freeze your account via official banking app and change all credentials

title: Bank Account Suspension & Urgent KYC Verification Fraud
indicators: Claims that your bank account, PAN card, or SIM card will be blocked/suspended within 24 hours
Instruction to download remote access APKs (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RustDesk, QuickSupport)
Unsolicited calls or messages from 10-digit mobile numbers claiming to represent bank compliance teams
Direct requests to provide Aadhaar, PAN, and OTP to avoid immediate deactivation
guidance: Banks never use regular personal mobile numbers to issue official KYC suspension alerts
KYC updates are carried out exclusively via verified bank branches or official authenticated mobile apps
Never install third-party screen sharing or remote management apps recommended by callers
Call your bank's verified customer helpline printed on the back of your debit card to verify status

title: UPI Collect Request & QR Code Payment Traps
indicators: Claims that entering your UPI PIN will 'credit' or 'refund' money to your account
Buyer on OLX or marketplace sends a QR code or UPI Collect request to 'pay' you
Unsolicited ₹1 test transaction followed by a large debit/collect approval request
Demands to approve transactions on Google Pay, PhonePe, or Paytm under the pretext of cashbacks or lotteries
guidance: Remember: You NEVER need to enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE money. UPI PIN is only required to send or debit money
Decline any unexpected UPI Collect requests immediately
Never scan QR codes sent by prospective buyers or customer care agents
Report fraudulent UPI IDs immediately on the respective payment app and to the National Cyber Crime portal (1930)

title: High-Yield Investment & Telegram Task Scams
indicators: Guaranteed risk-free returns (e.g. '200% return in 3 days', 'Daily 5000 from crypto trading')
Part-time 'YouTube video like', 'Google review', or 'Hotel rating' task schemes
Small initial payout made to build trust, followed by demands for VIP deposit recharge
Communication conducted entirely over Telegram or WhatsApp groups with fake investor testimonials
guidance: Legitimate investments carry market risks; anyone promising guaranteed high returns is running a scam
Task-based rating/like schemes are organized fraud rings designed to extract advance recharge deposits
Never transfer funds to private individual bank accounts for company investments
Verify investment firms on regulatory databases like SEBI or RBI before depositing money

title: Work-From-Home & Fake Recruitment Schemes
indicators: Unsolicited job offer received via WhatsApp/SMS without any formal interview or application
High salary offered for minimal work (e.g. ₹40,000/month for data entry or typing)
Requirement to pay an upfront 'registration fee', 'document verification fee', or 'laptop security deposit'
Sender email using free domains (@gmail.com, @outlook.com) while claiming to represent top multinationals
guidance: Legitimate employers never demand upfront fees, registration deposits, or training charges from candidates
Check company careers pages directly rather than relying on WhatsApp recruiters
Do not provide scanned copies of government IDs or bank statements to unverified recruiters
Block and report numbers circulating unverified remote typing or data entry jobs

title: Fake Customer Support & Search Engine Toll-Free Traps
indicators: Contact number obtained from unofficial search engine results, Google Maps edits, or social media comments
Agent insists on guiding you to send a payment or install remote access software to resolve an issue
Claims of refund processing requiring a reverse debit transaction
Refusal to handle queries through official in-app support chat
guidance: Only use support channels located inside official apps or the verified website footer
Never trust phone numbers listed in public forum comments or unverified Google Maps listings
Official support executives will never ask you to execute financial transactions to receive refunds
End the call immediately if asked to download screen-sharing utilities

title: Account Takeover, SIM Swap & OTP Theft
indicators: Caller poses as telecom representative offering '5G SIM upgrade' and asks for 20-digit SIM number
Repeated incoming OTP messages for password reset that you did not initiate
Urgent request to forward SMS or dial specific MMI codes (e.g. *21*phone_number# for call forwarding)
Sudden loss of cellular network reception accompanied by unauthorized banking alerts
guidance: Never forward SMS or dial secret call-forwarding codes provided by unknown callers
If your SIM suddenly loses service without explanation, contact your telecom operator immediately from another device
Enable hardware token or authenticator app 2FA instead of SMS wherever supported
Do not read out OTPs to any caller, regardless of who they claim to represent

title: National Cyber Defense & Essential Financial Safety Guidelines
indicators: High-pressure deadlines ('15 minutes left to respond')
Emotional manipulation (fear of arrest, fake police warrants, digital arrest scams)
Unusual payment methods (cryptocurrency, gift cards, direct UPI to personal accounts)
Requests to keep communications secret from family or bank staff
guidance: In India, report financial cyber fraud immediately to helpline 1930 or online at cybercrime.gov.in within the 'Golden Hour'
Law enforcement and police agencies never execute 'digital arrest' or demand money via video calls
Always consult a trusted family member or bank manager before acting on threatening messages
Remember FinSentry safety rule: Think Before You Trust
